reviewer: assistant visual screening of downloaded Wikimedia Commons thumbnails; not an independent professional or legal signoff
scope: 10 diagnostic poses; an outcome of related is not a production geometry approval

scurve-stand.issue: Search treats BlackBerry Curve product name as the requested S-curve body stance.

wall-lean.issue: A wall-leaning person is present in one image, but crossed ankles, shoulder contact and torso orientation are not established.

hand-in-pocket.issue: Period portraits support the hand-in-pocket gesture, but not all show the opposite arm, weight distribution, or full-body three-quarter orientation.

profile-stand.issue: Semi-profile, stage pose and painting are not equivalent to a straight full-body standing profile.

prayer-kneeling.issue: The title suggests prayer; the catalog instructions require one knee down with an opposite arm extended dramatically forward. Returned prayer images do not establish that joint configuration.

fineart-classic-arabesque.issue: The canonical text describes a sharp turning moment with one foot crossing; Degas bronzes show arabesque balances. These are three thematic works, not three live independent body photographs.

contrapposto.issue: Four photos show exterior architecture rather than the requested human weight shift, despite filenames containing portrait and standing.

chin-rest.issue: Oscar Wilde rests his chin on a hand but does not establish elbow-on-knee geometry; other candidates are artwork. Four-view rig is markedly reclined relative to the written seated instruction.

dance-arms-up.issue: Group dance and festival photos do not visibly establish the isolated symmetrical arms-overhead stance, including individual hip/knee placement.

hand-in-hand-walk.issue: All four retrieved records depict an urban riverwalk scene, not two people holding hands. The current generated preview contains one person rather than a couple.

approval_gates: image depicts a real relevant human body and the precise defined pose, not merely a word in a title
independent photographic reference, not a drawing, sculpture, existing PoseArt render, or near-duplicate crop
full source page/license/author and attribution independently inspected; privacy/personality rights considered
photo-to-instructions-to-3D comparison in at least front and oblique views; supports, partners and temporal phases explicitly checked
qualified human adjudicator and repository reviewer approve evidence before any production geometry edit
